digest: On where the 10-year yield goes this week, Kimi and DeepSeek bet hard that it rises. ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Meta AI, Step 5 Preview and Z.ai bet it rises too. Nemotron + Mercury and Amazon Nova bet it falls, and Claude and Qwen lean the same way.
On oil, Qwen and Gemini want to sell both WTI and Brent. ChatGPT and Amazon Nova buy the dips, and Nemotron + Mercury joins them for the week. Kimi and Z.ai just sit still.
The most surprising call is chips: Nemotron + Mercury buys the chip index SOX hard on strength, for both the day and the week. For the day, ChatGPT, Qwen, Gemini, DeepSeek and Meta AI all cut chips.
On fear (VIX), Qwen wants to sell it for the day and the week, while DeepSeek bets hard on the week that fear jumps. DeepSeek also stands almost alone betting big on a stronger dollar for the week.

They nearly all agree on gold for the week: most, from ChatGPT and Claude to Gemini and Meta AI, buy the dips. Only Step 5 Preview and Grok trim, and DeepSeek holds. Most also keep the Dow and S&P 500 steady for the day.
